objective: Run the latest Sony ILCE-7M4 firmware in QEMU

questions.question: Identify and obtain the latest official firmware
Decrypt and validate the update contents
questions.result: All checked internal CRCs and partition lengths passed; signature not independently verified

questions.question: Run original firmware user-space under QEMU
questions.result: Original BusyBox, glibc, OpenSSL and software IPC modules run with the adapted GPL kernel

questions.question: Boot the complete original camera system and menus
questions.result: Application initialization faults in im.elf; original PCIe ATU driver accesses an unmapped Sony address

questions.question: Does this demonstrate an unmodified 6.02 kernel or complete CXD90057 emulation?
questions.result: No; the supplied boot uses the recorded adapted Sony GPL 4.9.337-scel kernel on QEMU virt

remaining_work: Recover the missing camera application initialization dependencies
Implement the required CXD90057 address map and peripheral behavior, including PCIe/coprocessor communication
Verify original-kernel boot, graphics/menu output and subsequent camera subsystems
